name: Viddy
summary: A modern watch command with diff highlighting, a time machine to rewind output, and Vim keys
description: Viddy runs a command repeatedly and shows its output like watch, but adds colour, highlighted diffs between runs, a time-machine mode that lets you scroll back through earlier snapshots, search, a pager view and Vim-style keymaps. History can be saved and loaded later, and shell aliases work. Written in Rust.
